By the mid-2030s, Germany aims to recruit some 70,000 more full-time troops than it currently has on retainer, to reach a full-time force of around 260,000 plus around 200,000 reservists. UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) and EU Maritime Security Center Indian Ocean (MSCIO) both issued alerts that the vessel had been boarded by eight armed individuals near the Horn of Africa . What else do we know about the apparent piracy incident off the Horn of Africa? The UKMTO post advised vessels to "transit with caution and report any suspicious activity." Piracy on the Horn had fallen after raging through the 2000s and peaking around 2011; but 2026 has seen an uptick in activity, with several ships seized by pirates. Without naming him directly, the Metropolitan Police said he was found "unresponsive" in Battersea, south London , and pronounced dead at the scene. "At this time his death is being treated as unexpected, but is not believed to be suspicious," a spokesperson said. "His next-of-kin have been informed and are being supported by officers."
